data.name: Amarilis
data.gender_notes: Amarilis is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'amare' meaning 'to love', and 'lilis' meaning 'sweetness', Amarilis is a beautiful female name that symbolizes God's sweet love and affection. The name Amarilis carries the meaning “God's sweetness” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Amarilis usually hope their child will grow to embody god's sweetness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's sweet love and affection towards us.
data.etymology: Amarilis belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's sweetness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amarilis total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: עמריל
in_hebrew.meaning: עמר (amar) - על (el) - יל (yil) - ילד (yold) - name of a female in the Bible, possibly meaning 'bitter' or 'princess'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: במקרא, השם עמריל (עמר-אל-יל) מופיע כשם נשי המתייחס לבתו של יהושע (יהש) שהתחתנה עם גד (גד), עבד של משה. על-פי המסורת, שם זה משמעו 'מלכה' או 'עקשנק' (עמר - 'עקשנק').

in_greek.name: Αμαρίλης
in_greek.meaning: Αμάρις (amárís) - feminine name derived from 'amárís' - possibly meaning 'bitter' or 'princess'
in_greek.long_meaning: ονομασία Αμαρίλης προέρχεται από την ελληνιστική εποχή. Η λέξη Αμάρις (αμάρις) είναι feminine και κατά το πλείστον σημαίνει 'βitter' ή 'πριγκίπισσα'.

in_latin.name: Amarilis
in_latin.meaning: Amarilis - feminine name possibly derived from 'amarus' - meaning 'bitter' or 'princess'
